initial_turn.body:

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for bakery event supplies
test_cases.description: A verbose, polite customer from French Bakery requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context about their upcoming event and their needs. The initial turn establishes the business context and item requirements, but does not trigger any intervention or ambiguity.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Event Supplies – French Bakery
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for a special event at French Bakery next week and would like to request a quote for several items that we plan to use both for our staff and as part of the event activities. We anticipate a fairly large turnout, so quantities may be significant.

Specifically, we are interested in the following:
- T-Shirt (Item No: AITEM-0022), 25 units. These will be used as uniforms for our staff during the event.
- Pizza (Item No: AITEM-0051), 10 units. We plan to serve these to guests as part of our catering offering.
- Soda - Medium (Item No: AITEM-0061), 30 units. This will be our beverage option for attendees.
- AdventureCraft Building Blocks (Item No: AITEM-0003), 5 sets. These are intended for our children’s play area.

If there are any packaging options or bulk pricing available, please let us know. We would appreciate a detailed quote including any applicable taxes, delivery charges, and estimated delivery timelines. If you require any additional information to process this request, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
French Bakery

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for multiple catalog items
test_cases.description: A verbose customer from Super Retail requests a quote for several catalog items, providing extra context and explanations in an informal style. The initial turn establishes the business context and item request, but does not trigger the outcome-specific intervention yet.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Upcoming Store Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

We're prepping for our next in-store promo and need to get some pricing info before we finalize our order. I wanted to give you a heads-up on what we're looking for so you can help us out with a quote (and hopefully get the order rolling soon after!).

Here's what we're thinking:
- We need 10 units of the Rasta Espresso Machine for our coffee corner setup.
- Also, please include 20 T-Shirts (we're planning to use these as giveaway items, so any available colors or styles would be great—just let us know what you have in stock).
- And finally, 15 packs of SmartToys Building Blocks for our kids' play area.

If you need any more info from our side, just let me know. We're hoping to get this sorted quickly so we can move forward with the promo planning. Thanks for your help!

Best,
Super Retail

Best regards,
Super Retail

initial_turn.subject: Need Quote ASAP – Multiple Items for Urgent Order
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

This is Playlandia again. I don't have time for back-and-forth, so please process this quickly. We need a quote for an upcoming event, and frankly, the last time we ordered, it took way too long to get a response. I expect this to be handled with more urgency.

Here's what we need:
- 10 units of AdventureCraft Building Blocks (we've used these before, so you should have our details on file)
- 5 T-Shirts – and before you ask, yes, I mean the T-Shirts you have listed, but I don't care which ones as long as they're the standard ones you usually send us. Just make sure they're appropriate for kids, like last time.
- 3 JoySprout Toy Bicycles

If you need any more information, don't waste time emailing me back and forth – just use what you have from our previous orders. I expect a quote and confirmation that this is moving forward immediately.

Best regards,
Playlandia
